en.quote: If they had wanted to [kill him], they would probably have finished the job.
en.head: Navalny died in a penal colony in the settlement of Kharp on February 16, 2024.
en.body: The Yamalo-Nenets prison service said that after a walk the inmate “felt unwell and almost immediately lost consciousness”; resuscitation efforts failed. The agency did not state a cause of death. This entry makes no claim about the cause of death; it records the quote and the event date.

qsrc.t: RBC, report from the press conference

notes: The bracketed verb supplies an omitted object; no cause of death is implied.
